column1: # dahku1715 key, CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffree, 2026). Recovered on the cipher alone (no crib, no clear copy):
# simulated annealing on the 278 training signs (d01-e02) with a Polish character model learnt from the clear Deboli texts
# of this repository (targets/deboli17*), frozen (SHA-256 d51a88f5...) before the held-out block e03-e06 was decoded.
# 24 signs -> 20 letters; homophones a = + / P, z = W / N, y = z / l, w = b / C. N (a framed sign) decodes 'z' but is
# probably a nomenclator name in the reading (the subject of 'chcial assistere'). V (a barred sh-like sign) = g in the
# frozen key; a blind shape plate (Brice Dudout, 5 Nov 2026) found the shape of W at d05 and e05, so the reading uses z there
# (reading only; this frozen table and the measurement are unchanged; d07 was not asked). Sign names: see transcription.txt.
